Synthetic grid cities and one 76-zone real-structure case, with recorded
reference trajectories using the Porto Alegre distance parameters
`f(d) = (d + 5000)^(−β)`, self-interaction off, a₀ = R, direct substitution,
200 iterations.

## Attribution and licence of the `pa_small` network data

The routing graph and segment keys in `pa_small.npz` (`graph_edges`,
`graph_costs`, `zone_graph_index`, `zone_ids`, `segment_node1`, `segment_node2`)
are derived from OpenStreetMap street data for Porto Alegre.
**© OpenStreetMap contributors. Contains information from OpenStreetMap, made
available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0**,
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. As a database derived from OSM data,
these arrays are themselves made available under the ODbL 1.0 — separately from
the MIT licence that covers the prefcent code. The synthetic grid fixtures carry no
third-party data.
